tokenization: Pinned local snapshot; encode(add_special_tokens=False). Saved prompt and response text re-tokenization, not exact API token IDs or usage. Concatenation omits any missing transport/chat-template framing.
why_not_gpqa_replay: Only two single-turn requests exist; no returned response appears in a subsequent recorded request.
Installed agent_replay.py overrides max_tokens=1 and temperature=0; replay would exercise short initial prompts, not the thousands of generated history tokens.
Repeating two histories four times would create duplicated cache hits and would not constitute eight distinct real agents.
Adding a synthetic follow-up would change the recorded workload; existing synthetic full-context checks already cover a stronger admission envelope.

future_harbor_extraction.format: One actual chat-completions request body per line in chronological order; one file per real task conversation.
preserve: Exact message sequence and content, system prompt, tool calls, tool results and tools schema
Recorded sampling and request metadata in private source sidecar; original release values retained
Actual token usage when available, separately from pinned-tokenizer reconstruction
Source trial/task ID and source artifact digest
do_not: Copy raw task/prompt/response contents into compact reports or publication commits
Invent missing request messages from narrative logs
Treat script exit0 as success without checking calls_done/errors/preemptions
future_harbor_extraction.launch_gate: Coordinator reviews at least8 distinct histories if testingC8, measured max concurrent working-set demand against pool, and max_num_seqs8; nightly rung ordering remains separate. For fewer histories, replay only observed concurrency.
future_harbor_extraction.replay_requirements: Server --enable-prompt-tokens-details to expose cached tokens; original installed agent_replay.py --agents8 --time-cap-s600 --request-timeout-s3600 only after admission and remaining device-box checks. Script forces one-token replay responses: explicitly diagnostic, not scored release settings. Preserve original release caps/timeouts in source metadata.

steering: inputs.json reread; no steering.md found in bringup or model agentic_evals search

missing_reasons.exact_api_usage: Saved text may not retain all reasoning/control token IDs or chat framing; re-tokenized counts are reconstructions.
missing_reasons.C8_capacity: Only two single-turn GPQA histories; no defensible real multi-turn C8 workload yet.
